svg.aria-label: Experiment 05: the payment provider is made to stall past the client timeout. All twenty payments time out cleanly, the saga expires the bookings, and inventory compensates so stock returns to baseline. The whole chain resolves in about 21 seconds — far below the reservation TTL, the booking safety net and the recovery sweeper, so none of them fire.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: · a stalled payment must not strand a booking holding inventory

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The saga's unhappy path is where distributed systems rot quietly. Atlas assigns the settlement explicitly: PaymentTimedOut owns the INVENTORY_RESERVED -> EXPIRED transition.

svg.text: Complements Experiment 04: there the consumer died and the sweeper re-drove the charge. Here the consumer is healthy and the provider stalls, so the timeout is resolved in-process

svg.text: by the normal path — and recoveries_total staying at 0 is what proves the sweeper stayed out of it.
